question: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?
final_sql: WITH annual AS (SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID), lowest AS (SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total FROM annual GROUP BY Segment), seg_avg AS (SELECT a.Segment, SUM(a.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg FROM annual a JOIN lowest l ON a.Segment = l.Segment AND a.total_consumption = l.min_total GROUP BY a.Segment) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS SME_LAM_difference, MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS LAM_KAM_difference, MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS KAM_SME_difference FROM seg_avg;

SELECT r.year AS year,
       AVG(
         CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 +
         CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1, instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
         CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
       ) AS average_time_seconds
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r
  ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.time IS NOT NULL
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

FINAL("WITH champion_times AS ( SELECT r.year AS year, CAST(substr(res.time, 1, instr(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1, instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + CAST(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + instr(substr(res.time, instr(res.time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.positionOrder = 1 AND res.time IS NOT NULL AND instr(res.time, ':') > 0 ) SELECT year, AVG(seconds) AS average_time_seconds FROM champion_times GROUP BY year ORDER BY year;")

FINAL("WITH k8_magnet AS (
  SELECT s.City AS city,
         f.\"NSLP Provision Status\" AS provision_status
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-8'
    AND s.Magnet = 1
    AND s.City IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS number_of_cities,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN provision_status = 'Multiple Provision Types' THEN 1 END) AS multiple_provision_types_count
  FROM k8_magnet
)
SELECT k.city,
       COUNT(*) AS schools_in_city,
       stats.number_of_cities,
       stats.multiple_provision_types_count
FROM k8_magnet k
CROSS JOIN stats
GROUP BY k.city
ORDER BY k.city")
